title: odontites ruber subsp. litoralis
intro: Odontites ruber subsp. litoralis, commonly known as Red Toothed Odontites, is a plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's efficacy and potential side effects.
